header:
Debit vs credit:
which is safer?

cover.title: Debit or Credit: Which Is Safer?
cover.label: DEBIT?

lines.text: Debit or credit? They look the same, but they work very differently.
lines.say: Debit or credit? They look the same, but they work very differently.

lines.text: Debit spends money you already have. Credit borrows it, and you pay it back.
lines.say: Debit spends money you already have. Credit borrows it, and you pay it back.

lines.text: Paying a credit card on time can build your credit score. Debit doesn't.
lines.say: Paying a credit card on time can build your credit score. Debit doesn't.

lines.text: And fraud? Federal law caps your credit card liability at 50 dollars. With debit, your protection depends on how fast you report it.
lines.say: And fraud? Federal law caps your credit card liability at fifty dollars. With debit, your protection depends on how fast you report it.

lines.text: The catch: carry a balance on credit, and interest gets expensive fast.
lines.say: The catch: carry a balance on credit, and interest gets expensive fast.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.
